requirement: The service shall expose a public health endpoint that states it is simulation-only.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns 200 with status ok and simulation_only true.

requirement: Authorized read roles shall be able to list the seeded simulated fleet.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/fleet returns the three seeded aircraft in stable ID order.

requirement: Operators shall be able to submit a mission plan for a non-operational safety decision.
acceptance_criteria: A conforming mission returns approved=true and a projected recovery battery.

requirement: Operators shall be able to submit synthetic telemetry frames.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh in-order frame for a known aircraft returns HTTP 202.

requirement: The gateway shall accept only hold, return_home, and land commands.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI exposes exactly the three safe command values and accepted commands change simulated mode.

requirement: Auditors and maintainers shall be able to retrieve audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized audit roles receive the append-only event list; operators are denied.

requirement: Authorized read roles shall be able to retrieve assurance counters.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics include fleet, audit integrity, and rejection counters.

requirement: Only maintainers shall be able to reset the lab state.
acceptance_criteria: Maintainer receives HTTP 204 and other roles receive HTTP 403.

requirement: Mission validation shall reject waypoints above the configured lab ceiling.
acceptance_criteria: Any waypoint above 120 m causes a rejected mission decision.

requirement: Mission validation and telemetry evaluation shall detect the configured operating geofence.
acceptance_criteria: Plans outside the geofence are rejected and active breaches request return_home.

requirement: The safety engine shall reject plans through the synthetic restricted zone and request recovery on entry.
acceptance_criteria: Coordinates inside the configured rectangle trigger rejection or return_home.

requirement: Mission validation shall reject launch battery below the configured minimum.
acceptance_criteria: Battery below 30 percent causes rejection.

requirement: Mission validation shall reject plans whose projected battery is below the requested reserve.
acceptance_criteria: Projected recovery battery is calculated and compared with reserve.

requirement: Critical battery telemetry shall request land.
acceptance_criteria: Battery at or below 12 percent always results in land.

requirement: Critically degraded command-link telemetry shall request return_home.
acceptance_criteria: Link quality below 30 percent results in return_home.

requirement: Low-confidence sensor telemetry shall request hold when no higher-priority hazard exists.
acceptance_criteria: Confidence below 0.4 results in hold.

requirement: When multiple hazards exist, the fail-safe decision shall be deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: Critical battery takes priority over geofence, link, and confidence conditions.

requirement: Mission validation shall reject launch link quality below the configured minimum.
acceptance_criteria: Link quality below 55 percent causes a rejected mission decision.

requirement: Telemetry above the configured altitude ceiling shall request return_home.
acceptance_criteria: Altitude at 120 m remains nominal and altitude above 120 m results in return_home.

requirement: Protected endpoints shall require a valid X-Lab-Token.
acceptance_criteria: Missing and invalid tokens receive HTTP 401.

requirement: Each protected operation shall enforce its allowed roles.
acceptance_criteria: Observer, operator, auditor, and maintainer permissions match the access matrix.

requirement: Safe commands shall be rejected after their TTL or when timestamped too far in the future.
acceptance_criteria: Expired or future commands receive HTTP 409.

requirement: A command_id shall be accepted at most once per lab state.
acceptance_criteria: The second use of a command_id receives HTTP 409.

requirement: Telemetry sequence numbers shall increase monotonically per aircraft.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate and lower sequence numbers receive HTTP 409.

requirement: Telemetry shall include timezone information and fall inside the configured age/skew window.
acceptance_criteria: Naive, stale, and excessively future timestamps are rejected.

requirement: Mission, command, and aircraft identifiers shall use a constrained uppercase identifier format.
acceptance_criteria: Path-like or malformed identifiers receive HTTP 422.

requirement: Variable-length input fields shall have explicit limits.
acceptance_criteria: Waypoint count and reason length over their limits receive HTTP 422.

requirement: Audit events shall form a verifiable SHA-256 hash chain.
acceptance_criteria: Every event references the previous hash and the metrics endpoint reports a valid chain.

requirement: The project shall not expose real flight-control, radio, targeting, or payload interfaces.
acceptance_criteria: No route or dependency connects the lab to an aircraft or operational protocol.

requirement: Rejected mission, command, and telemetry counts shall be observable.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics increase after rejected requests.

requirement: The service shall publish an OpenAPI contract.
acceptance_criteria: /openapi.json defines protected APIs and the X-Lab-Token scheme.

requirement: The automated Python suite shall enforce at least 85 percent line and branch coverage.
acceptance_criteria: pytest-cov fails the job below 85 percent.

requirement: Pull requests and main-branch changes shall run validation, linting, type checking, tests, and browser checks.
acceptance_criteria: The CI workflow contains all stated stages.

requirement: The repository shall run static analysis and dependency auditing.
acceptance_criteria: Bandit, pip-audit, CodeQL, and Dependabot are configured.

requirement: Every baseline requirement shall have named verification evidence.
acceptance_criteria: tools/check_traceability.py exits successfully with no uncovered requirement.

requirement: State-changing request models shall reject unexpected object properties.
acceptance_criteria: An unrecognized request property returns HTTP 422 and no state change occurs.
